verdict.rationale: Lambda's first-party docs describe a Managed Slurm offering in which Lambda installs, manages and maintains the Slurm environment, monitors slurmctld and slurmdbd, and Slurm automatically schedules workloads. The docs also describe a Managed Kubernetes (MK8s) offering on 1-Click Clusters that is preconfigured with GPU/InfiniBand support so workloads deploy without extra setup, and both options are offered side by side. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the managed schedulers work as described.
